subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Google Vertex ADC setup contract after the Gemini guided-setup regression is fixed?
rationale: The patch changes provider auth semantics, setup-written config, marker credentials, and plugin manifest metadata rather than only repairing a local code defect.

options.title: Fix marker and accept ADC setup
options.body: Restore appGuidedSecret for the existing Gemini API key choice, then land the permissive Vertex ADC setup as the supported contract.

options.title: Narrow setup behavior
options.body: Require stricter setup-time evidence or fewer setup-written defaults while preserving the proven Vertex onboarding path.

options.title: Pause behind Vertex cluster
options.body: Keep this PR as proof while the broader Google Vertex provider boundary is settled in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Fix marker and accept ADC setup
recommendation.body: Restore appGuidedSecret for the existing Gemini API key choice, then land the permissive Vertex ADC setup as the supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across setup/catalog onboarding and Google Vertex auth hardening surfaces touched by the product decision.
